provider: ghproxy mirrors (ghproxy.net, ghfast.top) — free anonymous GitHub raw/release proxy

free_tier.stated: GitHub文件链接带不带协议头都可以，支持release、archive以及文件，右键复制出来的链接都是符合标准的，更多用法、clone加速请参考这篇文章。
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: No per-object cap is published; release and archive links are served through Cloudflare, file links redirect to jsDelivr, and project folders are unsupported.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention period is published for proxied files; release and archive links are served through Cloudflare and file links redirect to jsDelivr.

egress.terms: Free, anonymous, no key. These are community-run mirrors of the GitHub CDN, funded by volunteers. Hence the polyculture of hostnames (gh-proxy.com, ghproxy.net, ghfast.top, gh.api.99988866.xyz) and the constant churn.

tooling: Prefix form: https://ghproxy.net/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<ref>/<path> and .../https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<asset>. Nothing else to install.
chaining: Serves as an edge mirror for GitHub release assets alongside raw file mirrors. Proxies allow distributing reads across ghproxy.net, ghfast.top, and other mirrors for public release downloads.
limits_note: Per-IP bandwidth shaping restricts download rates. Probes observed approximately 128 KB/s on file retrieval, compared to higher throughput from alternative CDN endpoints.
reliability_note: Volunteer infrastructure, high churn — of four mirrors tested this session, gh-proxy.com and cdn.gitmirror.com failed to resolve/connect while ghproxy.net and ghfast.top both returned the full file. Treat as a bandwidth multiplier for large files, never as an availability guarantee. Their own issue trackers document the churn (hunshcn/gh-proxy#116 mirror list, 'ghproxy.com 打不开了').

extras.unit_note: free_tier.unit is 'mixed' because the headline is denominated in MiB or KiB, which the schema enum does not carry; the verbatim free_tier.stated keeps the true unit. See the storage-dossier handover.
extras.document_section: Edge CDN used as an object store
extras.verified_at_basis: re-checked against the first-party page on 2026-11-19 (a verify run); evidence rows dated by the seed pass, which ended 2026-10-21, keep that date as an upper bound
extras.quota_verbatim: No quota; it proxies raw.githubusercontent.com and release assets, so the ceiling is GitHub's own (100 MiB/repo file, ~1.95 TiB/release). Probed a 50,901,339-byte GitHub file through ghproxy.net: HTTP 200, correct Content-Length.
extras.limits_verbatim: per-ip-shaping is the real constraint — measured ~128 KB/s (7.1 MB in 55 s) on a 50 MB fetch, versus 11.3 MB/s from hop.js and 6.4 MB/s from jsDelivr. Rule 6 applies: measure a baseline before blaming the origin.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free, anonymous, no key. These are community-run mirrors of the GitHub CDN, funded by volunteers — hence the polyculture of hostnames (gh-proxy.com, ghproxy.net, ghfast.top, gh.api.99988866.xyz) and the constant churn.
extras.chaining_verbatim: A fourth free mirror for the same GitHub origin, and the only one that also carries *release assets* (which jsDelivr cannot see and raw.githack cannot serve). For a 20 TiB archive of 2 GiB release assets, rotating across ghproxy.net / ghfast.top / raw.githack / jsDelivr / Fastly's release-asset CDN gives five independent read paths over one storage bill.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Prefix form: https://ghproxy.net/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<ref>/<path> and .../https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<asset>. Nothing else to install.
extras.agent_focus: CDN / edge platforms as storage+egress: Fastly (free tier + Fast Forward OSS), Akamai/Linode, Bunny.net (storage + free origin->CDN transit), KeyCDN, CacheFly, Gcore, CDN77, StackPath status, Edgio/Limelight status, jsDelivr, unpkg, esm.sh, Statically, raw.githack, ghproxy mirrors. Question asked: which CDN gives free or near-free egress so a cheap origin becomes viable. Cloudflare R2 excluded per brief. Hard-probed every per-file cap with real GETs this session.

binding_note: one stream is shaped, and aggregate throughput is the shaped rate times the number of streams
